name: print-social-matcha-moodboard-widget-collage
title: Matcha moodboard with playlist widget, candle and yellow pill
whatItIs: A cream 4:5 collage with three rounded blocks: a green playlist widget with a Spotify logo and five matcha photos, a full-width photo of frothy matcha with a floating white candle, and a yellow pill holding cut-outs of a whisk bowl, candle and pink cup.
whatItMeans: Calm, aesthetic and cosy; the single green palette signals wellness and a soft lifestyle.
techniques: Borrow a familiar UI (music widget) as a layout to frame photos.
Stack rounded rectangles of different sizes to build a soft modular collage.
Keep the palette to green, cream and one sunny yellow.
Isolate objects in a pill strip for a product line-up.

vocabulary.definition: Layout imitating a UI component like a music card.
Modular rounded rectangles arranged like a bento.
A row of isolated objects on a colour band.
Photos chosen to share one hue.
